verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents AgentOS, an official toolkit/MCP server enabling AI agents to act on production accounts (read balances, create beneficiaries, issue cards), plus a separate developer connector for coding agents to access docs/sandbox, confirmed by a probe verifying the official MCP server doc page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of AgentOS working in practice beyond first-party docs.
